summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HOME OS Phase 6 (Aesthetics Engine) and regression testing of Phases 1-5. All Phase 6 features working correctly: granite texture on body::after, CSS variable --theme-accent defaults to #32CD32, 12px border-radius on cards/panels, Settings panel with theme section, 3 theme swatches (Neon Green, Neon Orange, Royal Blue), theme switching updates --theme-accent CSS variable, active theme label updates, and theme persists to localStorage. All regression tests passed for ARENA, NODE, navigation, and Wellbeing Check-in.

Phase 6: CSS variable --theme-accent defaults to #32CD32 (Neon Green)
Phase 6: CSS variable --radius is 12px
Phase 6: 12px border-radius on KPI cards, nav buttons, settings button, funnel pulse, climate card, genio card, sentry card
Phase 6: Settings panel opens with data-testid='settings-panel'
Phase 6: Theme section visible with data-testid='theme-section'
Phase 6: 3 theme swatches visible (theme-swatch-neon-green, theme-swatch-neon-orange, theme-swatch-royal-blue)
Phase 6: Clicking Neon Orange swatch changes --theme-accent to #FF5E00
Phase 6: Clicking Royal Blue swatch changes --theme-accent to #4169E1
Phase 6: Active theme label updates correctly (data-testid='theme-active-label')
Phase 6: Theme persists to localStorage (state.activeTheme)
Phase 6: Theme persists after page reload
REGRESSION: Header visible with clock, mode indicator, HOME OS logo

REGRESSION: Settings button in sidebar

REGRESSION: THE LEDGER shows products and transactions tables

REGRESSION: Genio Matrix device toggles work and persist to localStorage

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 (Aesthetics Engine) fully tested and working. All previous phases (1-5) regression tested and passing. Theme engine supports 3 colors: Neon Green (#32CD32), Neon Orange (#FF5E00), Royal Blue (#4169E1). Theme persists to localStorage under state.activeTheme. The app uses vanilla JS with no React/backend - all data in localStorage under 'homeOS' key. Wellbeing overlay appears on first load or can be triggered from Settings. SANCTUM and ORACLE modules are placeholder modules awaiting configuration.
